title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: Iran claims strike on UAE, UAE denies
preheader: The claim follows US strikes on Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Monday, August 31, 2026 — one story worth your full attention today, plus 8 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: Iran Says It Hit a UAE Air Base; UAE Says That Never Happened
stories.why_important: Iran's army says it fired drones at a UAE air base early Monday. The UAE calls that false. The dispute comes right after US strikes on Iranian rocket launchers, showing the war could pull in more Gulf states.
stories.what_overlooked: Coverage rarely mentions Al-Minhad hosts US troops, so any real strike there risks direct US-Iran combat.
stories.prediction: Watch for UAE or US confirmation, satellite proof, or new Iranian strikes within 72 hours.
